title: Why is this number everywhere?
summary: Veritasium explores why the number 37 turns up so often, drawing on Tom Magliery's collection of 37 sightings and a poll of about 200,000 people asked to pick a random number. It covers how humans choose numbers and why 37 stands out.
why: HN cites it in LLM randomness and number-picking threads as evidence that humans are also biased and predictable when asked for random numbers.

quote.text: humans are fairly predictable when trying to come up with random numbers, for example, have a look at this Veritasium video
